answer: A checkable claim should survive strangers looking at the same evidence. When a spiral is reported in a shared effort, the report is only useful if others can revisit the place, the time, and the method. A karst works the same way: its value is not in the word itself, but in independent people confirming it without being paid to agree. And haven reminds us that durable results usually grow slowly, through repeated, visible work, rather than appearing fully formed overnight.
